## Description

Steps: 1 Your profile · 2 Licence (council/authority, number, certificate upload; "Verification pending" notice) · 3 Clinic (name, address, CE reg./facility licence, GSTIN/TRN) · 4 Hours & fees · 5 Note templates (multi-select, used from P2/P3) · 6 Invite your team (optional). Progress autosaves; the user can leave and resume; "Finish · go to Today". Clinic mode supports several doctors and locations (owner who is not a doctor skips step 2).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each step validates per country (India council list/registration number; UAE DoH/DHA/MOHAP licence; GSTIN optional format check; TRN 15 digits) with errors shown under the field and announced via aria-live.
- [ ] **AC2.** Leaving mid-wizard and signing in again resumes at the same step with saved values.
- [ ] **AC3.** Until licence verification, the doctor can book and register patients; recording/signing capabilities are disabled with the designed notice (feature-level check, not just UI).
- [ ] **AC4.** Step 6 sends invitations through the P0 invitation flow (MDV-P0-013).
- [ ] **AC5.** Finishing lands on the role's home (Today for doctors, Front desk for owners/reception) and creates tenant, facility, membership, practice profile, hours and fee defaults.
- [ ] **AC6.** The whole wizard works at 768 px (tablet) and is keyboard-completable.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
